Doc Gen help

What each document is for, and answers to common questions. The same help is in the app under Menu › Help & FAQ.

Document types Drafts and issuing Payments Your data Ads and purchases

Document types

Quotation

A formal offer stating the goods or services, prices and terms you propose to a customer before any work begins. A quotation is not a request for payment. Once the customer accepts it, convert it into an invoice so the details carry over without re-entry.

Invoice

A request for payment for goods delivered or services rendered. It records what is owed, by whom and by when. Set a payment due date so that unpaid invoices are flagged as overdue. Payments you record against an invoice reduce its outstanding balance.

Receipt

Written confirmation that payment has been received. When you record a payment against an invoice, Doc Gen issues a matching receipt automatically. You can also create a standalone receipt for a sale that was paid on the spot.

Credit note

Reduces the amount owed on an issued invoice, for example after a discount agreed later, returned goods or an overcharge. No money changes hands; the invoice balance is lowered. Use a refund note if the customer has already paid and money is returned.

Debit note

Increases the amount owed on an issued invoice, for example for additional work, an undercharge or extra delivery costs. The invoice balance rises by the amount of the note.

Refund note

Records money returned to a customer against an invoice they have paid. It is issued automatically when you record a refund and reduces the amount received on that invoice.

Drafts and issuing

What is the difference between a draft and an issued document?

A draft is a working copy that you can edit, preview and change as often as needed. Issuing finalises the document: its content is locked and its PDF is stored exactly as shown, so the copy you send is the copy you keep.

Can I change a document after issuing it?

No. Issued documents are locked to preserve an accurate record. To correct an amount, issue a credit note or debit note against the invoice. If a document was issued in error, void it and create a new one; you can duplicate it to save time.

What does voiding a document do?

Voiding cancels an issued document while keeping it on record, marked as void. Its number is not reused, which keeps your numbering sequence complete. A voided document no longer counts towards balances or overdue totals.

Why does my document number have gaps?

Numbers are assigned in sequence. A voided document keeps its number, so a gap is never created silently. You can change formats, yearly resets and starting numbers under Settings › Document numbering.

Payments

How do I remind a customer to pay?

Open the unpaid invoice and tap Send reminder. Doc Gen writes a polite message with the amount, the due date and your payment details, which you can edit. Send it on WhatsApp (when the customer has a phone number), by email, or share it with the invoice PDF attached.

Can Doc Gen remind me when invoices are due?

Yes. Turn on Settings › Payment due reminders. You get a notification on the due date of an unpaid invoice, and again 3 days later if it is still unpaid. Tap it to open the invoice.

Where do I put my bank details?

In your business profile under Getting paid: bank, account name, account number and DuitNow ID. They are printed on invoices and included in payment reminders.

How do I ask for a deposit?

In a quotation, tap Ask for a deposit under the total and enter a percentage or an amount. The quotation shows the deposit and the balance due on completion. Once issued, tap Invoice the deposit; when you later convert the quotation, the full invoice subtracts the deposit invoice.

How do I add my signature or company stamp?

In your business profile under Signature and stamp: draw your signature with your finger or upload an image, add the name to print under it, and add a photo of your company stamp. They are printed on every new document.

How do I send a customer a statement?

Open the customer under Customers and tap the statement icon at the top. Choose outstanding invoices or all invoices in a period, then share or print the PDF. It lists each invoice with what was paid and what is still owed, plus how overdue it is.

How do I record a payment?

Open an issued invoice and tap Record payment. Enter the amount, date and method. Part payments are supported; the invoice shows its remaining balance until it is paid in full.

When is an invoice overdue?

An invoice becomes overdue when its payment due date has passed and a balance remains. Overdue invoices are highlighted on the Dashboard and can be listed with the Overdue filter under Documents.

Your data

Where are my documents stored?

Your business profile, customers and documents are stored on this phone. They are not uploaded to our servers.

How do I keep a backup or move to a new phone?

Go to Settings › Backup & restore. Save a backup file to this phone or share it to Google Drive, email or another location you trust. On the new phone, install Doc Gen and choose Restore from file. We recommend making a backup regularly.

What happens if I uninstall the app?

Uninstalling removes all documents stored on the phone. Make a backup first if you may need your records again.

How do I delete my account?

Go to Settings › Delete account, type "delete account" and confirm. If you signed in more than 10 minutes ago, you will be asked to sign in again to confirm it is you. The account is deleted immediately and cannot be recovered. Documents stored on this phone are not affected; uninstall the app or clear its data to remove those as well.

Ads and purchases

Why do I see ads?

Ads keep Doc Gen free to use. The free version shows a banner at the bottom of the main screens and, after you issue a document, at most one full-screen ad. Ads never appear while you are editing.

How do I remove ads?

Open Shop from the menu (or Settings › Remove Ads). It is a one-time purchase through Google Play that removes all ads permanently. You need to be signed in: purchases belong to your Doc Gen account, so signing in with the same account on another phone brings them back (Settings › Restore purchases).

How do I get the premium designs?

Open Shop from the menu. The Premium Designs pack is a one-time purchase through Google Play that unlocks every design in it for good. Tap any design you own to use it for new documents; issued documents keep the design they were issued with.

How do I manage ad privacy?

Where required in your region, you can review or change your ad consent at any time under Settings › Ad privacy choices.
